description_en: Queries the list of device upgrade tasks in a specified upgrade batch
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定升级批次下的设备升级作业列表
name: ListOTATaskByJob

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of device upgrade tasks to display per page in the response. Maximum value: 100.

<notice>The product of CurrentPage and PageSize must be less than or equal to 100,000.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
指定返回结果中，每页显示的设备升级作业数量。最大限制：100。

<notice>CurrentPage与PageSize相乘的值必须小于或等于100,000。
</notice>
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
If you specify this parameter, only device upgrade tasks in the specified status are returned.

CONFIRM: to be confirmed.
QUEUED: to be pushed.
NOTIFIED: pushed.
IN_PROGRESS: in progress.
SUCCEEDED: succeeded.
FAILED: failed.
CANCELED: canceled.

If you do not specify this parameter, all device upgrade tasks in the specified upgrade batch are returned
parameters.help_zh:
传入此参数，则查询指定升级状态下的设备升级作业。

CONFIRM：待确认。
QUEUED：待推送。
NOTIFIED：已推送。
IN_PROGRESS：升级中。
SUCCEEDED：升级成功。
FAILED：升级失败。
CANCELED：已取消。

不传入此参数，则查询指定升级批次下的全部设备升级作业
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the upgrade batch. This is the unique identifier of the upgrade batch. This is the JobId returned when you invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html, or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html. You can also view this value on the Update Package Details page of the over-the-air update package in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh: 升级批次ID，升级批次的唯一标识符。您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147480.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html返回的**JobId**。您也可以在物联网平台控制台上OTA升级包的**升级包详情**页查看
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The page number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1.

<notice>The product of CurrentPage and PageSize must be less than or equal to 100,000.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序。

<notice>CurrentPage与PageSize相乘的值必须小于或等于100,000。
</notice>
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The list of device names to query.

You can specify up to 50 device names.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify PageSize or CurrentPage. If you specify DeviceNames.N, PageSize, and CurrentPage at the same time, DeviceNames.N takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询的设备名称列表。

最多传入设备名称50个。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入PageSize和CurrentPage。如果您同时传入DeviceNames.N、PageSize和CurrentPage，则以DeviceNames.N为准
parameters.name: device_names

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

SimpleOTATaskInfo.description_en: The device upgrade task information returned if the call is successful. For more information, see the parameters in SimpleOTATaskInfo
SimpleOTATaskInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备升级作业信息。更多信息，请参见SimpleOTATaskInfo下的参数

DestVersion.description_en: The target version of the over-the-air update package for the upgrade
DestVersion.description_zh: 升级的目标OTA升级包版本

FirmwareId.description_en: The ID of the update package

JobId.description_en: The ID of the upgrade batch

ProductKey.description_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs

ProductName.description_en: The name of the product to which the device belongs

SrcVersion.description_en: The original firmware version of the device

TaskDesc.description_en: The description of the upgrade task. This parameter contains the specific fault information in scenarios such as device upgrade timeout or task cancellation
TaskDesc.description_zh: 升级作业描述信息。当设备升级超时、升级作业被取消等场景下，该参数承载具体的错误信息

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the device upgrade task

TaskStatus.description_en:
The device upgrade status.

CONFIRM: to be confirmed.
QUEUED: to be pushed.
NOTIFIED: pushed.
IN_PROGRESS: in progress.
SUCCEEDED: succeeded.
FAILED: failed.
CANCELED: canceled
TaskStatus.description_zh:
设备升级状态。

CONFIRM：待确认。
QUEUED：待推送。
NOTIFIED：已推送。
IN_PROGRESS：升级中。
SUCCEEDED：升级成功。
FAILED：升级失败。
CANCELED：已取消

Timeout.description_en:
The timeout period for the device upgrade, in minutes.

If no timeout period is specified when the batch upgrade is initiated, this parameter returns an empty value
Timeout.description_zh:
设备升级超时时间，单位是分钟。

如果发起批量升级未设置超时时间，该参数返回值为空

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the upgrade task was created, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: 升级作业创建时的时间，UTC格式

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the upgrade task was last modified, in UTC format
UtcModified.description_zh: 升级作业最后一次修改时的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

PageSize.description_en: The number of device upgrade tasks displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的设备升级作业数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of device upgrade tasks
Total.description_zh: 设备升级作业数量总计
